generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: stems 1 to 12 m tall, 10 to 30 cm across; 50 to 80 leaves, 1.4 to 2.3 m long, the petiole 25 to 50 cm; leaflets in 70 to 115 pairs, 19 to 32 cm by 8 to 15 mm, at 45 to 70 degrees. Drawn as a trunk 0.1 m in radius, rising 0.05 m a year; fronds 1.85 m long, the petiole 0.2 of them, 92 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.14 of the frond; 20 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 8 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records).

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: stems 1 to 12 m tall, 10 to 30 cm across; 50 to 80 leaves, 1.4 to 2.3 m long, the petiole 25 to 50 cm; leaflets in 70 to 115 pairs, 19 to 32 cm by 8 to 15 mm, at 45 to 70 degrees. The whole plant's height at 60 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 5 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: male cone cylindrical to long ovoid, 35 to 55 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: male cone 10 to 15 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: the microsporophyll's face rhomboid, 1.5 to 3 cm wide.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: male cone cylindrical to long ovoid.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: male cone light brown to orange-brown; the colour by eye.

traits.microsporophyll_spine_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: microsporophylls 3 to 5 cm, the face rhomboid, 1.5 to 3 cm wide, with a sharply upturned spine 2 to 8 mm long.

traits.megasporophyll_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: megasporophylls 25 to 35 cm long, on long stalks.

traits.megasporophyll_crown.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: megasporophylls open, on long stalks.

traits.megasporophyll_margin.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: lamina narrowly triangular, 5 to 10 cm by 2 to 4 cm, regularly toothed with 18 to 30 spines 2 to 8 mm long, and an apical spine 1 to 2 cm.

traits.megasporophyll_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: megasporophylls felted grey and orange; the colour by eye.

traits.ovules_per_megasporophyll.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: 3 to 8 ovules.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: seeds flattened ovoid, 4.5 to 6 cm long, with a wing-shaped apical crest.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: seeds 3.6 to 4.8 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: sarcotesta reddish brown to orange when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 143), Cycas seemannii: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
